context: A teacher discusses war research with a teen
purpose: Teach: 嘆く/本性/有様/人道的/勇敢/執念/スクープ/高学年

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 桜さん、戦時、本気で、絶対、市民が、絶対、暮らしを、絶対、嘆く、絶対、声、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、感心
lines.en: Sakura, the way you handled civilian voices during wartime in your paper was genuinely impressive.
lines.style: Warm, measured approval. Leans forward slightly. The tone of a teacher who has just finished reading something that surprised her in the best way. Steady eye contact, unhurried pacing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。戦時に、本気で、絶対、人の本性、絶対、現れる、絶対、こと、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you so much. I really tried to show how wartime reveals people's true nature in the paper. I'm grateful for the opportunity to research something so meaningful.
lines.style: Sincere, slightly flushed with genuine gratitude. Speaking carefully, as if the words matter. Respectful but not deferential—meeting the teacher as a fellow thinker. Steady voice.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時、本気で、絶対、町の有様、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、視野、広い、絶対、立派、絶対、本気で、感心
lines.en: And the way you captured the town itself during those years—that broader perspective was striking.
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Reflective tone, as if turning something over in her mind. Slower pace. Genuine recognition without flattery. Eyes engaged.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦時の、本気で、絶対、人道的支援、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I wanted to explore the humanitarian efforts during wartime, and I'm really grateful you pushed me to go deeper with that research.
lines.style: Grounded and direct. A nod of acknowledgment. The tone of someone who has understood what was being asked of her and risen to it. Quiet confidence underneath.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 戦時、本気で、絶対、勇敢な、絶対、市民、絶対、論文で、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: The way you handled the stories of brave civilians who resisted—that took real care to do justice to.
lines.style: Engaged, leaning in. Recognition in the voice. Not overstating, but clearly moved by the work. Warm but professional. The kind of encouragement that lands because it's specific.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦時、本気で、絶対、抵抗者の執念、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Yes. I tried to capture the determination and tenacity of those who resisted. I'm so grateful for your guidance through all of this.
lines.style: Quiet strength in the voice. Speaking from something real she discovered through the work. Respectful but assured. Not rushing. The words feel earned.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 当時の、本気で、絶対、各紙のスクープ、絶対、論文で、絶対、扱っていましたね、本気で、本当に、感心
lines.en: Even the contemporary newspaper accounts you incorporated—that archival detail really elevated the whole piece.
lines.style: Appreciative, noting the fine work. Slightly slower pace, savoring the detail. The tone of someone who sees what it took to find and weave those sources in. Genuine.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。戦時の高学年児童、本気で、絶対、教育、絶対、論文で、扱いました、本気で、本当に、深い、研究、絶対、感謝
lines.en: Thank you. I paid special attention to how wartime affected even the education of children during that period. I truly appreciate all your support in helping me research this thoroughly.
lines.style: Warm closing. Gratitude that feels complete rather than rushed. Eyes up, meeting the teacher's gaze. The tone of respect that has earned itself through work, not just politeness.
